$comment: Every localStorage key upstream Wickline uses (without the 'wickline.' prefix), and how the self-hosted edition treats it. test/contract/storage-keys.test.mjs fails when upstream adds a key that is not listed here, so a new upstream key is never synced or dropped by accident. Policies: cas = compare-and-swap (stale writes rejected), merge = id-based three-way merge, lww = last write wins (small preferences), local = never leaves the device.

workspace.note: layouts, charts, indicators; SYNC_WORKSPACE=false makes it local

paper.note: whole paper account, also written on beforeunload

drawings.*.note: one key per symbol; written directly by drawings.js

scripts.note: written directly by scripts.js; entries carry `updated`

theme.note: also read by the inline <head> script

lang.note: written directly by i18n.js; removeItem means follow the system

paint.note: derived first-paint cache, rewritten by theme.js

tdKey.note: secret: the user's Twelve Data key

state.note: legacy, read-only fallback for a missing workspace
